SELECT p.source_record_key AS packageSourceKey,p.shipment_time AS shipmentTime,c.contract_no AS contractNo, CASE WHEN p.shipment_contract_source_key IS NOT NULL AND p.shipment_contract_source_key<>'' AND p.shipment_contract_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.id IS NULL OR c.id<>p.shipment_contract_ref_id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS parentConflict,c.contract_type AS contractType FROM com_shipment_package p LEFT JOIN com_shipment_contract_reference c ON c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.source_system='DPPMS' AND ((p.shipment_contract_source_key IS NOT NULL AND p.shipment_contract_source_key<>'' AND CAST(c.source_record_key AS BINARY(128))=CAST(p.shipment_contract_source_key AS BINARY(128))) OR ((p.shipment_contract_source_key IS NULL OR p.shipment_contract_source_key='') AND c.id=p.shipment_contract_ref_id)) WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND p.source_system='DPPMS'
AND CAST(p.source_record_key AS BINARY(128)) IN CAST(#{key} AS BINARY(128))
AND 1=0
